card.title: Anything but That Question
card.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This holiday photo would make a lovely anniversary card. Look at that sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you prefer the beach photo? More room for a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same person, same bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That bracelet's exactly your colour. Shall I find you one for our anniversary?

mechanism: A turns attempts to identify a suspicious hand-holder into anniversary design and gift decisions.
confusable: Unlike denying wrongdoing, A avoids the identity question while using its details as new distractions.
comparison: The bracelet becomes a gift pitch, distinct from the key scene turning a suspected source into dinner logistics.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
